title: Make filename migration and status moves scope-compatible
description: Update flat-file filename validation, legacy UUID-filename migration, writeTask, replaceTask, and crash-residue cleanup to work with both accepted short-ID formats. A valid UUID-named scoped task must migrate to its scoped short-ID filename; status transitions must move only that task's exact scoped/legacy filename and still clean valid UUID residue. Preserve refusal to overwrite conflicting targets, duplicate UUID/short-ID detection, directory-status validation, and canonical export filenames. Add tests for scoped migration, scoped status moves, interrupted cleanup, conflicting targets, and unchanged legacy behavior.
